title: Quickstart telemetry schema draft (sheet) — v1
content:
Doc: Sheet-style working draft for Quickstart Templates telemetry contract v1.
Owner: Allison Grant (Observability standards)
Primary consumers: Template authors (Python/TS), SDK helpers, Console dashboards/alerts.

Notes / conventions
- We emit OpenTelemetry traces + metrics; logs are structured JSON and correlated to traces.
- “Low cardinality” = safe for metrics dimensions. “High cardinality” = logs/traces only.
- Do NOT include raw prompts, document contents, PII, API keys, authorization headers, or full URLs with querystrings.
- Use consistent attribute keys across languages.
- Routing: “route” should be stable (e.g., "/v1/chat/completions" or logical route name), not full URL.
- request_id: prefer Redwood request id header echoed back by API (if available) else generate UUID; keep in logs/traces.

TAB 0 — Status / open questions
1) Cost attribution metric: do we emit cost as (a) counter in USD micros (preferred) or (b) token-only and let Console compute? Nadia leaning toward cost counter for templates.
2) Tenant id: use RW_TENANT_ID env var? Or accept user-provided tenant tag? DX preference: optional but recommended.
3) RAG retrieval spans: what minimum attributes are required across vector stores? Proposed minimal set below.
4) Tool calling spans: should tool name be allow-listed and low-cardinality? Proposed: tool.name is low-cardinality if allow-list enforced.

TAB 1 — Metrics (OTel) schema
Columns: Signal | Metric name | Type | Unit | Required? | Recommended dimensions (LOW cardinality only) | Disallowed dimensions (HIGH cardinality) | Description | Cardinality notes | Console mapping

metrics | redwood.quickstart.request.count | counter | 1 | REQUIRED | service.name, deployment.environment, rw.template.name, rw.template.version, rw.language, rw.sdk.version, rw.endpoint, rw.region, rw.deployment_mode | rw.request_id, user_id, ip, prompt_hash, raw_model_response | Total inbound requests handled by the template service (API server). Increment once per request. | Keep rw.endpoint to a short stable label ("query", "ingest", "agent_run") rather than full path if possible. | Default dashboards: Traffic volume; Top routes
metrics | redwood.quickstart.request.latency_ms | histogram | ms | REQUIRED | service.name, deployment.environment, rw.endpoint, rw.region, rw.deployment_mode, rw.model (LOW-ish if curated list), rw.stream ("true"/"false") | rw.request_id, http.target, tool.input, vector.query | End-to-end server latency for the template endpoint. | rw.model dimension OK if catalog is limited; otherwise bucket to model_family (optional). | Latency p50/p95 by route; Streaming vs non-streaming
metrics | redwood.quickstart.request.error.count | counter | 1 | REQUIRED | service.name, deployment.environment, rw.endpoint, rw.error_class, rw.http_status | rw.request_id, error_message, stacktrace | Count of requests that ended in error (as classified). | rw.error_class must be from taxonomy (see TAB 4). | Error rate by class; Error rate by route
metrics | redwood.quickstart.request.timeout.count | counter | 1 | RECOMMENDED | service.name, deployment.environment, rw.endpoint, rw.timeout_scope ("client"|"server"|"tool"|"vector"), rw.upstream ("redwood"|"vector_store"|"tool") | rw.request_id | Count of timeouts encountered, including upstream timeouts. | This is used to quickly see misconfigured timeouts. | Timeout panels; Alert candidates (burn-rate)
metrics | redwood.quickstart.request.rate_limited.count | counter | 1 | RECOMMENDED | service.name, deployment.environment, rw.endpoint, rw.http_status ("429"), rw.retry ("true"|"false") | rw.request_id | Count of upstream rate limit responses (429) from Redwood API. | Don’t tag with exact retry_delay_ms (too high cardinality). | 429 panels; Rate limit troubleshooting
metrics | redwood.quickstart.llm.token.prompt | counter | token | REQUIRED (if calling LLM) | service.name, deployment.environment, rw.endpoint, rw.model, rw.region, rw.deployment_mode | rw.request_id, prompt_hash | Prompt/input tokens consumed for LLM calls. | Emit per LLM call or aggregated per request; be consistent (prefer aggregated per request). | Token usage breakdown; Cost panels (if token->cost conversion)
metrics | redwood.quickstart.llm.token.completion | counter | token | REQUIRED (if calling LLM) | service.name, deployment.environment, rw.endpoint, rw.model, rw.region, rw.deployment_mode | rw.request_id | Completion/output tokens consumed. | Same aggregation rule as prompt tokens. | Token usage breakdown
metrics | redwood.quickstart.llm.token.total | counter | token | REQUIRED (if calling LLM) | service.name, deployment.environment, rw.endpoint, rw.model, rw.region, rw.deployment_mode | rw.request_id | Total tokens (prompt + completion). | Should match prompt+completion within rounding. | Token usage; Budget monitoring
metrics | redwood.quickstart.llm.cost.usd_micros | counter | 1e-6 USD | RECOMMENDED | service.name, deployment.environment, rw.endpoint, rw.model, rw.region, rw.deployment_mode | rw.request_id | Estimated cost in USD micros for LLM calls (if available from SDK/API). | Prefer micros to avoid float issues. | Token-level cost breakdown; Budget alarms guidance
metrics | redwood.quickstart.llm.retry.count | counter | 1 | RECOMMENDED | service.name, deployment.environment, rw.model, rw.retry_reason ("429"|"timeout"|"conn_reset"|"5xx") | rw.request_id, error_message | Count of SDK retries attempted for upstream LLM calls. | Retry_reason from allow-list only. | Retry behavior panels; Support triage
metrics | redwood.quickstart.streaming.disconnect.count | counter | 1 | RECOMMENDED | service.name, deployment.environment, rw.endpoint, rw.disconnect_side ("client"|"server"|"proxy"|"unknown") | rw.request_id | Count of streaming disconnects observed mid-stream. | Classification can be best-effort; keep allow-list. | Streaming stability dashboard
metrics | redwood.quickstart.rag.retrieval.count | counter | 1 | RECOMMENDED (RAG templates) | service.name, deployment.environment, rw.vector_store ("pgvector"|"pinecone"|"weaviate"|"other"), rw.endpoint | rw.request_id, query_hash | Number of retrieval operations performed. | vector_store dimension is low cardinality. | RAG health panels
metrics | redwood.quickstart.rag.retrieval.latency_ms | histogram | ms | RECOMMENDED (RAG templates) | service.name, deployment.environment, rw.vector_store, rw.endpoint, rw.result ("hit"|"miss"|"error") | rw.request_id | Retrieval latency distribution. | Avoid dimensioning by top_k; log top_k instead. | RAG latency panels
metrics | redwood.quickstart.cache.hit.count | counter | 1 | OPTIONAL | service.name, deployment.environment, rw.cache ("llm_prefix"|"rag"|"http"|"none"), rw.endpoint | rw.request_id, cache_key | Cache hit count. | cache must be allow-list. | Cache effectiveness (optional)
metrics | redwood.quickstart.cache.miss.count | counter | 1 | OPTIONAL | service.name, deployment.environment, rw.cache, rw.endpoint | rw.request_id, cache_key | Cache miss count. | — | Cache effectiveness (optional)

TAB 2 — Trace attributes & span naming (OTel)
Columns: Span kind / name | Attribute key | Type | Required? | Example | Cardinality | Notes | Console mapping

Server spans (template API)
span | "HTTP {method} {route}" (SERVER) | service.name | string | REQUIRED | "quickstart-rag-api" | LOW | Standard OTel resource attribute (set via SDK/collector). | Service filter in Console
span | — | deployment.environment | string | REQUIRED | "local" / "staging" / "prod" | LOW | Resource attribute. | Env selector
span | — | rw.template.name | string | REQUIRED | "rag-fastapi" / "agents-node" | LOW | Stable template id. | Template dashboard grouping
span | — | rw.template.version | string | REQUIRED | "1.0.0" | LOW | Repo tag/version. | Version comparisons
span | — | rw.language | string | REQUIRED | "python" / "typescript" | LOW | Template language. | Template matrix
span | — | rw.sdk.version | string | REQUIRED | "py-0.18.2" / "ts-0.14.0" | LOW | SDK version used by template. | Regression triage
span | — | rw.request_id | string | REQUIRED | "req_01HT..." or UUID | HIGH | Put in spans/logs, not metrics labels. | Trace<->log correlation; support tickets
span | — | rw.tenant_id | string | RECOMMENDED | "acme-prod" | MED | If available. Encourage stable org/tenant key. | Multi-tenant views
span | — | http.method | string | REQUIRED | "POST" | LOW | Standard semantic convention. | HTTP breakdown
span | — | http.route | string | REQUIRED | "/query" | LOW | Do not use full path with ids. | Route grouping
span | — | http.status_code | int | REQUIRED | 200 | LOW | Standard. | Error rate panels
span | — | rw.endpoint | string | REQUIRED | "query" / "ingest" / "agent_run" | LOW | Logical endpoint label used in metrics. | Route grouping
span | — | rw.stream | bool | RECOMMENDED | true | LOW | Whether response streaming enabled. | Streaming panels
span | — | rw.error_class | string | REQUIRED on error | "rate_limited" | LOW | Must be from taxonomy (TAB 4). | Error analysis
span | — | rw.error_code | string | OPTIONAL | "RW_UPSTREAM_429" | LOW | Stable code strings only. | Error grouping
span | — | exception.type | string | REQUIRED on exception | "TimeoutError" | MED | Standard OTel exception. | Stack traces (if enabled)
span | — | exception.message | string | OPTIONAL | "upstream timeout" | HIGH | Avoid in metrics; ok in traces. Redact PII. | Deep debugging

Client spans (Redwood API calls)
span | "redwood.inference" (CLIENT) | rw.model | string | REQUIRED | "redwood/llama-3.1-70b-instruct" | LOW-ish | OK if models limited. If not, consider rw.model_family in addition. | Model comparisons
span | — | rw.region | string | REQUIRED | "us-west" | LOW | Use Redwood region names. | Region breakdown
span | — | rw.deployment_mode | string | REQUIRED | "hosted" / "dedicated" / "private" | LOW | Used to keep templates future-proof. | Deployment comparisons
span | — | rw.route_policy | string | OPTIONAL | "lowest_latency" | LOW | Only if template config supports routing. | Routing/fallback dashboards
span | — | rw.fallback_used | bool | OPTIONAL | false | LOW | If SDK indicates fallback. | Reliability dashboards
span | — | rw.token.prompt | int | REQUIRED (if available) | 1234 | — | Better to record as span events/attrs AND emit metrics. | Token exemplars
span | — | rw.token.completion | int | REQUIRED (if available) | 321 | — | — | Token exemplars
span | — | rw.cost.usd_micros | int | OPTIONAL | 18450 | — | — | Cost exemplars

RAG spans (retrieval)
span | "rag.retrieve" (INTERNAL) | rw.vector_store | string | RECOMMENDED | "pgvector" | LOW | Allow-list. | RAG panels
span | — | rw.rag.top_k | int | OPTIONAL | 5 | LOW | Keep as attribute only (not metric label). | Debugging
span | — | rw.rag.result_count | int | RECOMMENDED | 5 | LOW | For sanity checks. | Retrieval quality hints
span | — | rw.rag.cache | string | OPTIONAL | "hit"/"miss"/"none" | LOW | Allow-list only. | Cache panels
span | — | rw.rag.query_hash | string | OPTIONAL | "sha256:…" | HIGH | Use only if needed; beware correlation risk. | Rare debugging only

Agent/tool spans
span | "agent.plan" (INTERNAL) | rw.agent.name | string | OPTIONAL | "support_agent" | LOW | Stable workflow id. | Agent dashboards
span | "tool.call" (INTERNAL) | rw.tool.name | string | REQUIRED (if tools) | "search_kb" | LOW | Must be allow-listed; don’t include user-controlled tool names. | Tool performance panels
span | — | rw.tool.timeout_ms | int | RECOMMENDED | 15000 | LOW | Attribute only. | Tool SLO checks
span | — | rw.tool.result | string | RECOMMENDED | "success"/"error"/"timeout" | LOW | Allow-list. | Tool error panels
span | — | rw.tool.error_class | string | REQUIRED on error | "tool_timeout" | LOW | Use same taxonomy where possible. | Error analysis

TAB 3 — Structured log fields
Columns: Field | Type | Required? | Example | Cardinality | Notes | Console mapping

@timestamp | string | REQUIRED | "2026-01-03T18:22:11.120Z" | — | ISO-8601. | Log timeline
level | string | REQUIRED | "INFO" | LOW | Standard levels. | Filtering
message | string | REQUIRED | "request completed" | HIGH | Keep short and generic; no PII. | Human readability
service.name | string | REQUIRED | "quickstart-agents-api" | LOW | Match OTel resource. | Service filter
deployment.environment | string | REQUIRED | "staging" | LOW | — | Env filter
rw.template.name | string | REQUIRED | "agents-node" | LOW | — | Template filter
rw.template.version | string | REQUIRED | "1.0.0" | LOW | — | Version filter
rw.language | string | REQUIRED | "typescript" | LOW | — | Template matrix
rw.sdk.version | string | REQUIRED | "ts-0.14.0" | LOW | — | Regression triage
rw.request_id | string | REQUIRED | "req_01HT…" | HIGH | Primary support correlation id. | Support workflows
trace_id | string | REQUIRED | "7b3bf…" | HIGH | For trace->log join. | Trace correlation
span_id | string | OPTIONAL | "e0f1…" | HIGH | Useful for pinpointing. | Trace correlation
rw.tenant_id | string | RECOMMENDED | "acme-prod" | MED | Stable tenant key; do not log emails/domains if avoidable. | Tenant breakdown
http.method | string | RECOMMENDED | "POST" | LOW | — | HTTP context
http.route | string | RECOMMENDED | "/agent/run" | LOW | — | Route context
http.status_code | int | RECOMMENDED | 200 | LOW | — | Error grouping
rw.endpoint | string | REQUIRED | "agent_run" | LOW | Must match metric dimension. | Route grouping
rw.model | string | OPTIONAL | "redwood/llama-3.1-70b-instruct" | LOW-ish | OK if curated model list. | Model drilldowns
rw.region | string | OPTIONAL | "us-west" | LOW | — | Region drilldowns
rw.deployment_mode | string | OPTIONAL | "hosted" | LOW | — | Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private
rw.stream | bool | OPTIONAL | true | LOW | — | Streaming diagnosis
rw.error_class | string | REQUIRED on error | "rate_limited" | LOW | From taxonomy. | Error rate by class
rw.error_code | string | OPTIONAL | "RW_UPSTREAM_429" | LOW | Stable code only. | Error grouping
rw.retry_attempt | int | OPTIONAL | 2 | LOW | For upstream call logs only; avoid per-token. | Retry diagnosis
rw.backoff_ms | int | OPTIONAL | 400 | LOW | OK in logs; avoid as metric label. | Retry diagnosis
rw.token.prompt | int | OPTIONAL | 1234 | LOW | Consider logging only at INFO with sampling to avoid noise. | Cost triage
rw.token.completion | int | OPTIONAL | 321 | LOW | — | Cost triage
rw.cost.usd_micros | int | OPTIONAL | 18450 | LOW | — | Cost triage
rw.rag.doc_count | int | OPTIONAL | 5 | LOW | No doc ids/titles. | RAG health
rw.tool.name | string | OPTIONAL | "search_kb" | LOW | Must be allow-listed. | Tool dashboards
rw.tool.latency_ms | int | OPTIONAL | 83 | LOW | — | Tool performance

Logging hygiene notes
- Don’t log request/response bodies.
- Don’t log full exception stack traces at INFO; use ERROR with sampling/limits.
- Scrub headers: Authorization, Cookie, Set-Cookie, X-API-Key, etc.
- For user identifiers: prefer stable internal tenant_id; avoid end-user ids.

TAB 4 — Error taxonomy (for rw.error_class + error codes)
Columns: rw.error_class (allow-list) | When to use | Example error_code | Notes

ok | Request completed successfully | — | Not emitted as error_class; absence implies success.
rate_limited | Upstream returned 429 or local rate limiter triggered | RW_UPSTREAM_429 / RW_LOCAL_RL | Should correlate with request.rate_limited.count metric.
timeout | Any timeout (client/server) where request fails | RW_TIMEOUT_UPSTREAM / RW_TIMEOUT_TOOL | Also increment request.timeout.count.
upstream_5xx | Redwood API 5xx responses | RW_UPSTREAM_5XX | Include upstream status.
network_error | DNS/TLS/connection reset | RW_NET_CONN_RESET | Often seen with proxies.
validation_error | Invalid input (schema, missing fields) | RW_VALIDATION | Return 400.
auth_error | Invalid/missing API key | RW_AUTH | Return 401/403; avoid leaking details.
config_error | Missing env var, invalid config | RW_CONFIG | Usually 500 during startup; fail fast.
vector_store_error | Retrieval/DB failure | RW_VECTOR_ERR | Also tag rw.vector_store.
tool_error | Tool execution failed (non-timeout) | RW_TOOL_ERR | Tool name must be allow-listed.
prompt_safety_block | Template guardrail blocked prompt/tool use | RW_GUARDRAIL | Should not include raw prompt in logs.
unknown | Catch-all | RW_UNKNOWN | Use sparingly; investigate.

TAB 5 — Cardinality guardrails (quick reference)
LOW (OK in metrics dims): deployment.environment, service.name, rw.template.name, rw.template.version, rw.language, rw.sdk.version, rw.endpoint, rw.region, rw.deployment_mode, rw.stream, rw.error_class, rw.http_status, rw.vector_store, rw.tool.name (if allow-listed)
MED (be careful): rw.model (OK if curated), rw.tenant_id (OK if tenant count is bounded; recommended for Dedicated/private customers)
HIGH (NO metrics dims; logs/traces only): rw.request_id, trace_id/span_id, raw URLs, user ids/emails, prompt hashes, query hashes, document ids/titles, tool inputs/outputs, exception.message (can be PII)

TAB 6 — Mapping to Console dashboards (baseline)
Dashboard panels we expect to work out-of-box with this schema:
- Latency: redwood.quickstart.request.latency_ms p50/p95 by rw.endpoint; split by rw.stream
- Errors: redwood.quickstart.request.error.count / request.count by rw.error_class; top rw.endpoint
- Rate limits: redwood.quickstart.request.rate_limited.count over time; correlate with retries
- Timeouts: redwood.quickstart.request.timeout.count by rw.timeout_scope
- Token usage: llm.token.prompt/completion/total by rw.model and rw.endpoint
- Cost: llm.cost.usd_micros by rw.model, rw.endpoint (if emitted)
- RAG: rag.retrieval.latency_ms + rag.retrieval.count by rw.vector_store
- Tools: (if agent template) group tool.call spans by rw.tool.name and rw.tool.result; optionally emit tool metrics later

Implementation reminders for template authors
- Ensure trace context propagation across inbound request -> Redwood API call spans -> tool calls.
- Always include rw.request_id in logs + traces; do not attach as metric label.
- Emit request.count and request.latency_ms for every request (including errors).
- For streaming: measure latency as time-to-last-byte (TTLB) for server span; optionally log time-to-first-token as attribute/event.

Changelog (working)
- 2025-12-08: Initial draft created (Allison)
- 2025-12-12: Added cost metric + rate_limit + streaming disconnect (Nadia, Sean)
- 2025-12-16: Added tool allow-list constraints + vector store minimal attrs (Monica, Dana)
- 2025-12-19: Tightened cardinality guardrails; added Console panel mapping (Sergio, Logan)
